name: Form Solid Waste Disposal

business_logic: 1. Load draft solid_waste_disposal_record by id (route param) beserta seluruh solid_waste_disposal_detail turunannya ke form state
2. Auto-set Date = hari ini HANYA jika draft baru (masih kosong); jika draft dilanjutkan, pertahankan nilai tersimpan

3. Render field dikelompokkan per section: Identitas Solid Waste Disposal (Solid Waste Disp. ID, Date), Verifikasi (Inputted By [read-only], Checked By, Acknowledged By, Note), Log Kejadian (tabel event-log)
4. Render breadcrumb (Home > Production Process Activity > Solid Waste Disposal > Form, tappable) dan header dengan hamburger

5. On Tambah baris Log Kejadian: tambah 1 baris baru (tanpa id) ke tabel, seluruh field kosong — TIDAK ADA batasan jumlah baris (event-log unbounded), TIDAK ADA konsep N-kolom/checklist seperti Cages Track
6. On isi field baris (Tanggal Kejadian, Shift, dll): update field baris tersebut secara reaktif; Net Weight (MT) dihitung otomatis = Gross Weight - Tare Weight setiap kali salah satu berubah
7. On Hapus baris Log Kejadian: hapus baris dari form state; jika baris punya id (sudah tersimpan sebelumnya), tandai untuk DELETE saat Simpan/Pause berikutnya
8. Checked By hanya dapat diisi/diedit jika role user saat ini = supervisor; disabled untuk role lain
9. Acknowledged By hanya dapat diisi/diedit jika role user saat ini = mill_management; disabled untuk role lain

10. On Simpan: validasi field wajib (Solid Waste Disp. ID) dan minimal 1 baris Log Kejadian valid (Tanggal Kejadian terisi) → jika lengkap: UPDATE solid_waste_disposal_record (semua field header, status=saved) → upsert solid_waste_disposal_detail (baris tanpa id: INSERT baru dengan Net Weight terhitung; baris dengan id: UPDATE; baris ditandai dihapus: DELETE) → navigasi ke Monitor Solid Waste Disposal

11. On Pause: UPDATE solid_waste_disposal_record (field form apa adanya, status=draft_paused, TANPA validasi field wajib), solid_waste_disposal_detail rows di-upsert/delete apa adanya juga → navigasi ke Monitor

12. On Clear: tampilkan dialog konfirmasi → jika dikonfirmasi: DELETE seluruh solid_waste_disposal_detail milik record lalu DELETE solid_waste_disposal_record → navigasi ke Monitor; jika dibatalkan: tidak ada perubahan
13. On Back: jika form dirty: tampilkan dialog konfirmasi → jika dikonfirmasi, buang perubahan di memori, navigasi ke Monitor; jika tidak dirty, navigasi langsung
14. On tap breadcrumb segment → navigasi ke route terkait
15. On tap hamburger → buka menu navigasi (Ganti Password, Logout)

data_operations.description: SELECT record by id untuk load form state
UPDATE semua field header + status=saved pada Simpan, atau field apa adanya + status=draft_paused pada Pause
INSERT baris baru (tanpa id sebelumnya) pada Simpan/Pause
UPDATE baris yang sudah punya id pada Simpan/Pause
DELETE baris yang dihapus user dari log, pada Simpan/Pause berikutnya; atau seluruh baris pada Clear
DELETE record pada Clear yang dikonfirmasi

edge_case_handling.condition: Field wajib (Solid Waste Disp. ID) belum lengkap saat Simpan
edge_case_handling.handling: Tampilkan error inline per field, record tidak tersimpan

edge_case_handling.condition: Belum ada baris Log Kejadian dengan Tanggal Kejadian terisi saat Simpan
edge_case_handling.handling: Tampilkan pesan error khusus pada bagian Log Kejadian, record tidak tersimpan
Field disabled/read-only untuk role selain supervisor
Field disabled/read-only untuk role selain mill_management

edge_case_handling.condition: User menghapus baris Log Kejadian yang sudah ada (punya id)
edge_case_handling.handling: Baris hilang dari log; ditandai untuk DELETE eksplisit
Field form + tabel Log Kejadian terisi dari draft tersimpan
Tampilkan dialog konfirmasi wajib sebelum DELETE dieksekusi

business_rules_applied: Date otomatis sekali saat draft baru dibuat
Checked By hanya Supervisor, Acknowledged By hanya Mill Management
Log Kejadian adalah event-log bebas, jumlah baris tidak dibatasi
Minimal satu baris Log Kejadian dengan Tanggal Kejadian terisi sebelum Simpan
Net Weight dihitung otomatis per baris, tidak dapat diedit manual

unit_test_cases.description: sets date to today when draft is new (empty)
unit_test_cases.given: loaded draft record has date = null
unit_test_cases.expect: date set to today's local date exactly once on mount

unit_test_cases.description: preserves stored date when resuming a paused draft
unit_test_cases.given: loaded draft record has date already set

unit_test_cases.description: computes net_weight_mt for a row as gross_weight_mt minus tare_weight_mt
unit_test_cases.given: a row with gross_weight_mt=10 and tare_weight_mt=2

unit_test_cases.description: adds a new empty row with no upper bound on row count
unit_test_cases.expect: each call appends one new row with id undefined; no limit enforced

unit_test_cases.description: queues an existing row (with id) for deletion when removed, does not delete rows without id immediately
unit_test_cases.given: a row with id='existing-1' is removed
unit_test_cases.expect: row removed from local rows array; its id appended to the pending-deletion list

unit_test_cases.description: disables the Checked By field for a non-supervisor user
enables the Checked By field for a supervisor user
disables the Acknowledged By field for a non-mill_management user
returns validation errors and does not save when Solid Waste Disp. ID is empty on Simpan
unit_test_cases.expect: validation fails, inline error returned, saveDraft() not called

unit_test_cases.description: returns validation error and does not save when no detail row has an event_date on Simpan
unit_test_cases.given: all detail rows lack event_date, Simpan triggered
unit_test_cases.expect: validation fails with detail-specific error, saveDraft() not called

unit_test_cases.description: saves with status=saved when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: required header fields filled, 1 valid detail row, Simpan triggered
unit_test_cases.expect: saveDraft() called with status='saved'; navigation to Monitor triggered

unit_test_cases.description: updates record with status=draft_paused without validating required fields on Pause
unit_test_cases.given: required field is empty, Pause triggered
unit_test_cases.expect: pauseDraftWithFormData() called with current field values as-is, status='draft_paused', no validation errors; navigation to Monitor triggered

unit_test_cases.description: shows confirmation dialog before deleting on Clear
unit_test_cases.expect: confirmation dialog displayed; deleteDraft() not yet called

unit_test_cases.description: deletes record and all its detail rows, then navigates to Monitor when Clear is confirmed
unit_test_cases.expect: solid_waste_disposal_detail rows deleted, solid_waste_disposal_record deleted; navigation to Monitor triggered

unit_test_cases.description: shows confirmation dialog on Back when form is dirty
unit_test_cases.given: form state isDirty = true, Back pressed

unit_test_cases.description: navigates directly on Back when form is not dirty
unit_test_cases.given: form state isDirty = false, Back pressed
unit_test_cases.expect: navigates to Monitor immediately, no dialog shown

implementation_notes: Simpan/Pause/Clear bersifat lokal (SQLite); pengiriman ke server terjadi lewat mekanisme sync manual terpisah, di luar scope screen ini

Berbeda dari Cages Track: TIDAK ADA konsep N-kolom checklist/jam — Log Kejadian murni tabel bebas per-kejadian, mengikuti pola cages-tipped-time hanya dari sisi 'unbounded rows added manually', bukan dari sisi struktur kolomnya
Hapus baris mengikuti pola queue-for-deletion (baris dengan id ditandai, baru DELETE eksekusi saat Simpan/Pause berikutnya), konsisten dengan Form Cages Track
Net Weight (MT) dihitung client-side lalu dipersist, tidak pernah dihitung ulang oleh repo saat load
